name: dsh-heatmap

name: dsh-plugin-open-app

description_zh: DeepSeek API 额度面板折叠为左侧边框把手：点击展开查看余额、官方精确今日已消费（配置平台 token 后）与实时对话费用；dsh-deepseek-quota 的修改版。

author: Max-Samson
description: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.

name: DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider
author: MEMZ-JZY

description_zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

name: dsh-codex-pet
author: mengyun233
description: Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full
description_zh: 把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

name: dsh-sticky-note
author: Meredith2328
description: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description_zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

author: mexiaosqwq
description: Mobile-adaptive layout for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes a content-hugging overlay drawer, the conversation gets the full width, and the settings panel becomes a near-full-width sheet.

name: dsh-restart-fab
author: miisaka19800
description: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.

name: dsh-toolfold
author: Minecraftbe
description: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description_zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

name: dsh-chat-index-rail
author: Mobai-read

description_zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

name: widget-dock
author: MorGogh
description: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/
description_zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、用量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

name: mmx-quota-tool
author: mtty-ai
description: MiniMax token-plan quota dock for the Web UI: a drop-shape 5h-usage % chip in the conversation input area, click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage and reset countdown, auto-hi

name: token-usage-counter
author: Mu-scorpio
description: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description_zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

name: dsh-answer-pet
author: Nanki-nn
description: Animated blue-whale desktop pet with per-session response progress, model activity and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.

name: dsh-voice-input
author: NewDaNew
description: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.
description_zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框一键麦克风按钮，基于 Web Speech API 语音转文字填入草稿，可选识别后自动发送。

name: deepseek-harness-desktop#packages/dsh-desktop-base
author: ningbainb
description: Desktop feature aggregate that installs the DSH Web UI collection, dshmarket, Codex Connect, and reasoning-effort controls at pinned versions.
description_zh: 桌面版基础功能聚合包：按固定版本安装 DSH Web UI 合集、dshmarket、Codex Connect 与推理强度控制。

name: dsh-explorer
author: No-PRM

description_zh: Git 优先的文件树侧栏：VS Code 风格层级线、M/A/U/D/R git 状态装饰、HEAD 与工作区对照预览、媒体预览、拖拽引用（文件/文件夹/选中代码带行号）—— 纯插件。

name: dsh-spend
author: nonewind
description: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description_zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

name: folder-tree-sh
author: Nothree-code

description_zh: 工作区文件树插件：多标签预览（文本/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/图片）、Markdown 内联编辑、Git 变更面板与右键文件操作（重命名/删除/复制/移动/新建）。

author: Nothree-code
description: Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).

name: dsh-ocgo-lite
author: OK-wx
description: OpenCode Go usage bar in the composer dock: rolling/weekly/monthly quota rings, DSH-session token & cost stats priced with live official rates, per-model and current-session scope breakdowns with live
description_zh: 输入框下方常驻 OpenCode Go 用量条：5 小时/每周/每月配额圆环，DSH 会话 token 与花费统计（官方实时定价），支持按模型与按「本次会话」范围联动明细（本次会话实时更新），一键复制 API Key。

name: dsh-annotation
author: omdsh-dev
description: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description_zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

name: DSH-better-sidebar
author: omdsh-dev
description: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description_zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

name: ex-setting
author: omdsh-dev

description_zh: DSH 的设置扩展。

description_zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

name: dsh-agfs

name: deepseek-harness-tui
author: openma-ai
description: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.
description_zh: Rust/ratatui 终端客户端，直接使用 DSH SDK JSON-RPC 协议，支持独立运行或作为 profile bundle 加载。

name: dsh-side-monitor
author: pc439527
description: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.

name: deepseek-harness-genui
author: pengyue-polaron

name: harness-widgets

author: pppolf

author: qjcnmd

name: dsh-plugin-msg-nav
author: SherUnlocked-4869

description_zh: 对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

author: siberiah2o

name: dsh-smooth-stream

author: stevenx65

description_zh: dsh 网页侧边栏的 DeepSeek 余额与 token 用量监控：今日/累计切换，并按 provider 过滤其他厂商。

name: dsh-files
author: taxueseek
description: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.
description_zh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容嗅探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。

description_zh: 把 AI 每次文件写入/编辑记录为 before/after 快照，供 VS Code 内联 review 使用（逐块接受/撤回、单文件撤销，不依赖 git）。

name: dsh-workspace-search
author: tsonglew
description: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.

name: dsh-plugins#dsh-lan-gateway
author: TZHR-invest

name: dsh-plugins#dsh-mobile-ui
author: TZHR-invest
description: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.
description_zh: Web GUI 移动端适配：窄屏全宽响应式布局、会话抽屉、44px 触摸目标、安全区适配与阅读增强，桌面端零影响。

name: dsh-outline

author: tuogusa

author: wsxwj123

name: dsh-oh-my-theme
author: zhxqc

description_zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

name: dsh-tier-router
author: BruceLanLan

name: dsh-llm-fallbacks

description_zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

author: dylan121322

description_zh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

name: deepseek-harness-wallet
author: feibi-mochi
description: Multi-provider wallet chip: official DeepSeek balance, per-session cost & tokens, third-party token totals, recharge shortcut, low-balance alerts.
description_zh: 多供应商钱包标签：官方 DeepSeek 余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方合计 token、一键充值、低余额提醒。

name: keyringseam
author: fieldnote-ops

author: franksong2702

description_zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description_zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

author: jiay98528-dev

author: jyh20030112

author: kaixinbaba
description: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description_zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

name: dsh-everything-oauth
author: kam74515-boop
description: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
description_zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

description_zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

description_zh: 四模块会话伴侣：对话智能导出（Markdown/PDF/JSON/PNG 长图、隐私脱敏、批量 ZIP）、上下文交接摘要（模板保存与导入继承）、API 成本优化（官方动态计价、峰谷调度、日/月双档预算、模型路由）、全局对话检索与对话内搜索（Ctrl+F、CSS Custom Highlight API）。

name: task-passport
author: dongsheng123132
description: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description_zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

name: dsh-session-unarchive
author: dylan121322
description: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
description_zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

name: dsh-solo-thinking
author: fredalxin
description: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sideba
description_zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

name: dsh-agent-message
author: GengDaPeng
description: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

name: dsh-side-chat
author: heartmove
description: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description_zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

name: dsh-share
author: hellodigua
description: Share your conversations with one click.
description_zh: 一键分享你的对话。

name: dsh-plugin-session-import
author: huguangyu666
description: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description_zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

name: dsh-incognito
author: HuiHuitie-zhu
description: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description_zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

name: dsh-agent-team-room
author: ishuowang
description: Coordinate independent DSH Sessions and provider-backed members without merging their histories, using persistent native Rooms with identity-bound leading `@` mentions, direct delivery, broadcasts, an
description_zh: 在不合并对话历史的前提下，将多个独立 DSH Session 与 provider-backed 成员组成持久原生 Room，支持绑定精确成员身份的行首 `@` 提及、定向投递、广播和 Leader 权限控制。

name: dsh-rolehub-bridge
author: ishuowang
description: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent
description_zh: 发现并校验可移植的 RoleHub 角色，固定其精确 bundle，再将提示词和随角色打包的 Skills 加载到独立、可续聊的 DSH Session，以 Host 批准的工具绑定限制能力，并可选接入 Agent Team Room。

name: dsh-sideband
author: ishuowang
description: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bea
description_zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

name: dsh-crosstalk
author: Jesse-njx
description: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
description_zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

name: claude2dsh
author: kirkchinese
description: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description_zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

name: dsh-messages-sanitizer
author: Leeminjing
description: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description_zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

name: dsh-session-search-pro
author: LeslieWylie
description: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first sca
description_zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

name: dsh-task-relay
author: LeslieWylie
description: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.
description_zh: 跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

name: dsh-recall-plugin
author: limbo947
description: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description_zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

name: dsh-plugin-session-delete
author: lsz-asd
description: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache
description_zh: 在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

name: dsh-chinese-thinking
author: Max-Null
description: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description_zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

name: dsh-session-doctor
author: mayf3
description: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
description_zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

name: dsh-message-edit
author: Moeblack
description: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description_zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

name: dsh-prompt-studio
author: Moeblack
description: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
description_zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

name: dsh-archived-sessions
author: MuWinds
description: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
description_zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

name: review-quote-sh
author: Nothree-code
description: Message review and quote chips for conversations: multi-model cross review (code/reply) with severity grading and summaries, review history, and host-persisted preferences.
description_zh: 对话消息审查与引用：多模型并行互审（代码/回复审查、严重度分级、综合汇总）、引用问答胶囊、评审历史与偏好记忆。

name: dsh-chat-import
author: Nwflower
description: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude C
description_zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

name: dsh-file-claim
author: Nwflower
description: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description_zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

name: dsh-task-control
author: p2coder
description: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning fin
description_zh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

name: dsh-bookmarks
author: penguin-oo
description: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description_zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

name: dsh-session-link
author: PwnKY
description: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description_zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

name: dsh-session-move
author: reinocheong
description: Move a session to another folder from the Web UI via drag & drop or a menu picker, permanently delete a session with a risk-consent dialog, and AI-rename a session by summarizing the whole conversatio
description_zh: 在 Web 侧边栏把会话移动到别的文件夹（拖拽或菜单选择），带风险确认地永久删除会话，以及 AI 重命名会话（总结整个对话并自动纠正错别字）；每个操作都提供 agent 工具。

name: dsh-prompt-manager
author: SaiSenBox
description: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
description_zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

name: dsh-queue-plus
author: starslittle
description: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
description_zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

name: dsh-session-nav
author: tuogusa
description: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps.
description_zh: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转。

name: dsh-session-tags
author: tuogusa
description: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
description_zh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

name: dsh-archived-chats
author: Ultronen
description: Archived Chats settings page for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, unarchive, and delete archived sessions grouped by workspace — deletion takes effect immediately, no restart needed, even for session
description_zh: DSH 已归档聊天管理页：浏览、搜索、取消归档与删除已归档会话，按工作区分组；删除即生效、无需重启，后台驻留的会话也能当场彻底删除。

name: dsh-suite#plugin-session-export
author: whyihaveyou
description: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description_zh: 把 append-only 会话日志导出为按轨迹来源分组的可读 Markdown 或 HTML。

name: dsh-prompt-stash
author: Wine-Red
description: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description_zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

name: dsh-plugins#dsh-session-manager
author: wsxwj123
description: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI.
description_zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。

name: dsh-whale-companion
author: xianshu-virtuous
description: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.
description_zh: 接近上下文上限时自动创建新 Web 会话并只转移最后一个完整回合，同时提供可编辑的追加式鲸鱼娘人格与按需重读工具。

name: dsh-session-report
author: yangyongzhen
description: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
description_zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

name: dsh-session-flow
author: YeqingTang
description: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, content search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking.
description_zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、内容检索、规则+LLM 双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。

name: dsh-explain
author: yuezengwu
description: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
description_zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

name: dsh-period-report
author: zhengjy01
description: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description_zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

name: dsh-shelf
author: zoahdev
description: Session lifecycle CLI: export (md/json/jsonl), archive/restore, trash, search, and stats. Read-only by default; nothing is ever deleted by the engine.
description_zh: 会话生命周期 CLI：导出（md/json/jsonl）、归档/恢复、回收站、搜索与统计。默认只读；引擎从不删除任何东西。

name: dsh-minimal-first-turn
author: ZRui-C
description: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the firs
description_zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

name: dsh-active-context-pruning
author: aerince
description: Model-authored context pruning for DeepSeek Harness through the official compaction API.
description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型驱动上下文裁剪插件，通过官方 compaction API 释放上下文空间。

name: dsh-auto-memory
author: Aik358
description: Auto-memory for DSH: three-layer memory (user / project notes / daily logs) with automatic injection, per-turn auto-consolidation, AI greetings, smart search, a calendar view and a settings page, plus
description_zh: DSH 自动记忆插件：三层记忆自动注入与检索、每轮对话自动沉淀、AI 时段问候与三级抽屉、智能检索、日历视图与设置页，支持继承其他 AI 工具的记忆。

name: dsh-negative-ledger
author: akslcw
description: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence
description_zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

name: dsh-memory-protocol
author: baaai123
description: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
description_zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

name: dsh-context
author: bowenliang123
description: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.
description_zh: 上下文洞察面板：一眼看清模型上下文窗口的组成与变化——构成对照窗口大小、按请求历史趋势、压缩/注入事件、消息级 token 统计。

name: dsh-eli-mode#packages/eli-mode
author: CeilCelia
description: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description_zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

name: dsh-handoff
author: FleetingEcho
description: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-com
description_zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

name: dsh-memory
author: flymysql
description: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description_zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

name: sgme
author: freehul
description: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / w
description_zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

name: dsh-free-vision
author: FuzzySoul
description: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
description_zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

name: dsh-memory-gate
author: GIT121995
description: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection
description_zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

name: dsh-qrcode
author: hellosky983
description: Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 离线二维码（SVG/PNG/ASCII）与条码（Code128/EAN-13）生成器，无网络、无 shell。

name: dsh-skillradar
author: hellosky983
description: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
description_zh: 扫描当前会话可见的技能，按与最近对话的相关性排序推荐。

name: dsh-native-memory
author: highland0971
description: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic re
description_zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

name: dsh-file-memory
author: ICCuse
description: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.
description_zh: 文件型工作记忆：memorize/recall 把关键前提逐字保存在会话笔记文件，无损挺过上下文压缩。

name: dsh-knowledge
author: ICCuse
description: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
description_zh: 全局知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex 共享的 D:\knowledge（格式逐字节兼容）。

name: dsh-premise-guard
author: ICCuse
description: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
description_zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。

name: dsh-memoria
author: jiayan-xu
description: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with

author: bwndlct
description: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
description_zh: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

name: dsh-ssh-ops
author: caoyiwei850
description: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the righ
description_zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

author: cdxiaodong
description: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
description_zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。

name: dsh-asimovbox
author: cerebrixos-org
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.
description_zh: 通过 API 密钥认证的工具将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 AsimovBox，用于创建、更新、渲染和完成视频。

name: dsh-cache-precision
author: Cheng-cheng9669
description: Renders the built-in cache-hit percentage with three decimals and widens the composer stats line to prevent truncation.
description_zh: 把内置缓存命中率原位显示为 3 位小数，并加宽底部统计行避免内容被截断。

name: dsh-mcpguard
author: ChenLaoshiYF
description: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
description_zh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

name: blender
author: CheshireJCat
description: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; instal
description_zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

name: dsh-learning-mode
author: CHplus0
description: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output
description_zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

name: Gemini-Eyes
author: ConsoleSun
description: MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.
description_zh: 接入 gemini.google.com 的 MCP 桥：图片/视频视觉识别、Imagen 生图、Veo 生视频与历史对话管理，复用浏览器登录态，无需 API Key。

name: dsh-wechat-mp
author: coolbreezecoin
description: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeCh
description_zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

name: dsh-chat-imagine
author: corrinehu
description: Generates images in DeepSeek Harness through configured OpenAI-compatible image models or a local MiniMax CLI, and displays the result in chat.
description_zh: 通过已配置的 OpenAI 兼容生图模型或本机 MiniMax CLI，在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中生成并展示图片。

name: dsh-plugin-suite#dsh-plugin-center
author: crTnT
description: Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.
description_zh: 插件中心：在设置页发现、安装与管理 DSH 插件。

name: dsh-plugin-suite#dsh-plugin-updater
author: crTnT
description: Update manager for installed plugins: check for updates, back up, and roll back.
description_zh: 已装插件更新管理：检查更新、备份与回滚。

author: CZX2244
description: Bilibili video analysis: metadata, transcript (ASR fallback via Bijian/sherpa-onnx/whisper.cpp), comments, danmaku, and sharp keyframes with optional local vision descriptions.
description_zh: B站视频分析工具：提取元数据、字幕文稿（必剪/本地 ASR 兜底）、评论与弹幕，抓取清晰关键帧并可选本地视觉描述。

name: dsh-starter-pack
author: Dariandai
description: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
description_zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

name: dsh-free-search
author: DDDMUC
description: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an eng
description_zh: DSH 免费搜索插件：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、设置页 UI（API key 输入 + 官网链接）、web_fetch、引擎测试工具。

name: dsh-trajectory-governance

name: dsh-imagegen

description_zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

name: DSH-Office
author: didclawapp-ai

name: dsh-better-deepseek
author: EdgeTypE

description_zh: [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。

description: Adds a path-backed attachment dock for images, documents, archives, code, and other files, leaving file reading to the Agent's available tools.
description_zh: 为图片、文档、压缩包、代码及其他文件提供路径附件 Dock，文件读取交由 Agent 的当前可用工具完成。

name: dsh-full-remote
author: JUANWANG-BUAA
description: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, opt

name: dsh-zhihu-dashboard
author: kexuejin
description: Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/g
description_zh: 知乎面板：热榜（带趋势标记）、关注动态（收藏/创作/关注的人）、帖子追踪（问题/关键词/关注的人，支持自动创意简报），并提供 5 个对话工具（zhihu_search / hot / answer / global_search / followees）。

name: dsh-plugin-autoevo
author: klarkxy
description: Reuse-first capability evolution for agents: resolve existing tools and skills, discover and review exact-commit DSH plugins, install with one-time approval, verify real tool round trips, and minimall
description_zh: 面向 Agent 的“复用优先”能力演进层：先解析已有工具与 Skills，再发现并审查锁定 commit 的 DSH 插件，经一次性批准安装并验证真实工具往返；部分匹配则最小改进，而非从零重造。

name: dsh-packer
author: KLRSL
description: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack manage
description_zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、恢复差异对比、包管理与设置面板。

name: dsh-mobile-gui-agent
author: kunjinkao-os
description: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.
description_zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。

name: dsh-office-tools
author: kw78
description: Workspace-safe Office tools for agents: create/read Word, create/read/update Excel, and create/read PowerPoint decks with PNG/JPG/GIF image placement.
description_zh: 面向 agent 的工作区安全 Office 工具集：创建/读取 Word、创建/读取/更新 Excel、创建/读取 PowerPoint，并支持 PNG/JPG/GIF 图片排版。

name: dsh-browser-control
author: kyo615
description: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after e
description_zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

name: dsh-agent-preset-recommender
author: LeemanCheung
description: Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capa
description_zh: 有界、隐私安全的本地扫描器：汇总 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 元数据，原子保存密钥化聚合证据，并确定性推荐 DSH 内置 preset 与可选能力；不保留正文、不联网、不修改 preset。

name: dsh-image-gen
author: LeemanCheung
description: GPT Image 2 `image_gen` with Codex subscription OAuth by default or explicit API-key mode: developing card, up to three live API partials, durable attachment replay/lightbox/download, text-only model
description_zh: GPT Image 2 `image_gen`：默认复用 Codex 订阅 OAuth，也可显式使用 API Key；显影卡片、最多 3 张 API 实时局部图、持久附件回放/灯箱/下载、纯文本模型输出和受限的凭据安全请求。

name: dsh-fleet-audit
author: LeslieWylie
description: Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministi
description_zh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

name: dsh-md-preview
author: LeslieWylie
description: Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both shar
description_zh: 把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

name: dsh-tool-search
author: Letter2025
description: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description_zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

name: dsh-compressor
author: lifeodyssey
description: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description_zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

name: dsh-undo-plugin
author: lire1131
description: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).
description_zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

name: ai4scholar-plugin-dsh
author: literaf
description: AI4Scholar academic search: 38 tools over Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI resolution (search, citation graph, authors, recommendations, PDF full text in slice
description_zh: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

name: dsh-code-intel
author: lonelymoon87
description: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.
description_zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。

name: dsh-plugin-grok2api-media-tool
author: lsjspl
description: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description_zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

name: dsh-plugin-device-info
author: lsz-asd
description: Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os c
description_zh: 只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

name: dsh-plugin-knowledge-graph
author: Luke-Yong
description: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).
description_zh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。

name: dsh-http-tools
author: lussey820
description: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, and in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison.
description_zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比。

name: dsh-subagent-cwd
author: lynx-gt
description: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.
description_zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。

name: dsh-subagent-tools
author: lynx-gt
description: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
description_zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

name: dsh-scholar
author: lzszq
description: Academic assistant plugin.
description_zh: 学术助手插件。

description: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description_zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

name: dsh-bash-terminal
author: MAXeaglet

author: maxiaovivi

description_zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

name: dsh-Kimi-WebBridge
author: MicroHEROX
description: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that r
description_zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

name: dsh-koboldcpp-hands
author: MicroHEROX
description: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle manag
description_zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

name: dsh-unsloth-hands
author: MicroHEROX
description: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, ne

name: dsh-custom-tool
author: omdsh-dev
description: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
description_zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。

name: dsh-data-agent
author: omdsh-dev
description: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
description_zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

description_zh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。

description: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
description_zh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。

description: base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.
description_zh: base64/url/hex 编解码、常用哈希、UUID 生成。

name: dsh-tool-json
author: omdsh-dev
description: JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
description_zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。

name: dsh-tool-markdown
author: omdsh-dev
description: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
description_zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

name: dsh-tool-regex
author: omdsh-dev
description: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
description_zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。

name: dsh-tool-schema
author: omdsh-dev
description: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
description_zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。

name: dsh-tool-stat
author: omdsh-dev
description: Descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distributions, and correlation.
description_zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。

name: dsh-tool-time
author: omdsh-dev
description: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
description_zh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。

name: dsh-toolkit
author: omdsh-dev

description_zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。

author: pengxuding

name: dsh-checkpoint-rewind

description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

name: dsh-lsp-actions

description_zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

name: dsh-searxng
author: rogerdigital
description: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
description_zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description_zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

name: dsh_workflow
author: icetomoyo
description: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.
description_zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

name: dsh-routines
author: Jesse-njx
description: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.
description_zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

name: dsh-auto-approve
author: Jiao-XXX
description: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
description_zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

name: dsh-anchored-standard
author: Jungod1121
description: Two-phase agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro: the first request sees only bash+read (Minimal-aligned bootstrap), then the full Standard tool catalog after the first tool call or reply; ships as an insta
description_zh: V4 Pro 两阶段 agent 预设：首轮仅 bash+read 完成极简开局，首个工具调用或回复后恢复 Standard 完整工具目录；以安装器 bundle 与手动预设目录双形态发布。

name: dsh-captain
author: KanoNoUta
description: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.
description_zh: GPT 规划依赖 DAG，DeepSeek Worker 自适应并行执行任务，可选 GPT Reviewer 审核增量 Git Diff 并驱动返工轮次。

name: DSH-EvoResearch#evoresearch-plugin
author: Karbo123
description: Research agent suite: long-horizon goal control with auditable evidence chains, cron scheduling, multi-agent expert teams, self-evolving research memory (FTS5 + RRF recall), project workspaces, and a
description_zh: 科研 agent 套件：长程目标控制（可审计证据链）、定时任务、多智能体专家团队、自进化科研记忆（FTS5 + RRF 召回）、科研项目工作区与自定义工作台界面。

name: dsh-ops-kit
author: LeslieWylie
description: Evidence-first operating kit: six read-only tools (capability catalog, staged workflow plans, packaged skill reader, bounded local memory search, repository release audit, release checklist) and five
description_zh: 证据优先的操作套件：六个只读工具（能力清单、分阶段编排计划、随包技能阅读、有上限的本地记忆检索、仓库发布审计、发布清单）加五个随包技能；只规划与审计，不做远程写入。

name: dsh-approval-llm
author: Letter2025
description: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description_zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

name: dsh-model-failover
author: Letter2025
description: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description_zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

name: dsh-aura-scheduler
author: ljsysfurryACE
description: Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.
description_zh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

name: dsh-specflow
author: lonelymoon87
description: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description_zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

name: dsh-ci-context
author: lucas-ward
description: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
description_zh: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

name: paperlab
author: maple-pwn
description: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description_zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

name: dsh-agent-relay
author: Noelune
description: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description_zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

name: folio#plugins/folio-events
author: nyantused-cpun
description: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description_zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

name: folio#plugins/folio-tools
author: nyantused-cpun
description: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the f
description_zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

name: dsh-deep-research
author: omdsh-dev
description: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.
description_zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。

name: dsh-inspect
author: omdsh-dev
description: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
description_zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

name: dsh-auto-review
author: PerryLink
description: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
description_zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

name: dsh-doublecheck
author: PerryLink
description: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
description_zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

name: dsh-dual-agent-presets
author: QlzqQlzq
description: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
description_zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

name: dsh-apex-standard
author: rinDBeans
description: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog manage
description_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

name: dsh-longtask-orchestrator
author: rocker2018-droid
description: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
description_zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

name: dsh-plugin-automations
author: Sev7een
description: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
description_zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

name: uagent-sync#packages/dsh
author: severin-ye
description: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description_zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

name: dsh-auto
author: simon300000
description: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
description_zh: 为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

name: dsh-automation
author: titanwings
description: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.
description_zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。

name: dsh-plannotator
author: titanwings
description: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.
description_zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

name: agent_team_gui
author: toolclub
description: Reusable agent squads with per-agent provider/model routes and tool policies, serial/parallel dispatch, spawn/fork/chain context modes, and a Web management panel.
description_zh: 可复用 Agent 小队：每个成员独立配置 provider/model 路由与工具策略，支持串行/并行派单、spawn/fork/chain 上下文模式和 Web 管理面板。

name: dsh-agent-team-gui
author: toolclub
description: Global persistent agent squads with per-agent model/tool policies: manage them in Settings, select and toggle one per conversation, then collaborate on normal sends in a fixed or model-planned order.
description_zh: 全局持久 Agent 小队：每个成员独立配置模型与工具策略；在 Settings 中管理、按对话选择并开关协作，普通发送按固定顺序或由模型规划执行。

name: dsh-plugin-hooks
author: truelove-dreamer
description: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description_zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

name: dsh-code-reference
author: victorzhong0110
description: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
description_zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

name: dsh-loop
author: vlln
description: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description_zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

name: dsh-suite#plugin-team-board
author: whyihaveyou
description: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description_zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

name: dsh-review-loop
author: wuxiangru915
description: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.

name: dsh-ci
author: xxiaoxiong
description: Provider-neutral CI/CD capability for DeepSeek Harness with GitHub Actions support, bounded failure evidence, source-aware diagnostics, and approval-gated rerun/cancel controls.
description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的通用 CI/CD 能力，支持 GitHub Actions、有限失败证据提取、源码定位诊断，以及带审批控制的重跑与取消操作。

name: dsh-article-publish
author: yangyongzhen
description: Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
description_zh: 会话内直接发布文章到 CSDN / 掘金 / 博客园，无外部服务。

name: dsh-git-workflow
author: yangyongzhen
description: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
description_zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

name: dsh-scheduler
author: yangyongzhen
description: Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
description_zh: cron / 一次性定时任务：按调度执行 shell 命令或投递 webhook，结果可推送到 ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

author: ZhenHuangLab
description: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
description_zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

name: dsh-perlica-ding

description_zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

author: AbcdefgXW

description_zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

name: dsh-sound
author: AI-Galaxy-GPU

description_zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

author: Alan2Z

name: dsh-lark-link
author: amlyczz

description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

name: dsh-notify
author: aokamoaki
description: Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conver
description_zh: 对话完成通知：回合完成/出错/目标完成/提问/审批时弹出 Windows toast 与提示音，仅后台提醒，会话头部铃铛即控制中心。

name: dsh-im-bridge
author: BiBoyang

description_zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

name: dsh-web-ui-notify

description: Desktop notification reminders.
description_zh: 桌面通知提醒。

name: dsh-webbridge
author: bill9109
description: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
description_zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

name: dsh-unread-dot
author: Bing-Bryan
description: macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.
description_zh: macOS Dock 角标与提示音：最小化/切走时 Dock 显示未读角标（运行中=红点、跑完=数字）并播放水泡提示音，回到应用自动清除，基于 Badging API。

name: dsh-acp-for-bitfun
author: bobleer
description: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
description_zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

name: kongmu-im-bridge

description_zh: 通过 Unix socket 把 DSH agent 的会话、工具调用与审批实时桥接到 CodeIsland macOS 刘海面板，可直接在面板上批准/拒绝。

name: tuning-engines-cli#tuningengines-dsh-plugin
author: cerebrixos-org

description_zh: 将不含原始内容的 DSH 回合、模型、工具、审批、重试和错误事件导出到 Tuning Engines，用于受治理的追踪、策略评估、成本分析和 Work Session 审阅，并提供磁盘持久化重试队列。

description_zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

name: dsh-dingo
author: february2015

description_zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description_zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

name: dsh-web-launcher
author: hanwuji1

description_zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

name: telegram

name: dsh-lark

description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

name: deepseek-harness-acp
author: openma-ai

name: dsh-credentials-vault
author: tancheng33

name: dsh-spill-s3
author: tancheng33
description: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
description_zh: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

name: dsh-auth-gate
author: TecFancy

author: truelove-dreamer

author: skiuniverse
description: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
description_zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

name: dsh-codex-pet#dsh-codex-pet
author: skr311
description: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
description_zh: 导入/上传 Codex 风格精灵图序列帧宠物，在 DSH Web GUI 以悬浮浮层渲染，含图库管理、交互与 Agent 状态联动。

name: dsh-digipet
author: swaylq
description: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.
description_zh: 数码宝贝式养成：孵一颗吃真实工作长大的蛋（回合、工具调用、报错都是营养），按你的工作方式走四条进化分支；零 token，模型完全看不见。

name: dsh-wildmon
author: swaylq
description: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the mo
description_zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

name: dsh-coyote
author: THEWOLFWALKER
description: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, di
description_zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

name: whale-girl
author: vlln
description: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description_zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

name: dsh-stickers
author: william-jin-cmu
description: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.
description_zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。

name: lazeword
author: xczhanjun
description: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standal
description_zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

name: dsh-MusicPlayer
author: xiekai886
description: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.
description_zh: 可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

name: dsh-homepage-skin
author: yushi-xxh
description: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description_zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

name: dsh-expression
author: yyh-001
description: Meme search, the fun way: describe the vibe, and the agent finds and sends a real meme that actually fits.
description_zh: 陪 AI 斗图的搞笑插件：说个感觉，AI 帮你搜到、发出那张恰到好处的真实表情包。

name: dsh-pet-evolve
author: zoahdev
description: The pet that grows with your agent: 5 evolution stages earned from real signals (verified rules, completed sessions, tool calls, compactions), agent-state mirroring, and one-click growth share cards.
description_zh: 会随 agent 成长的宠物：真实信号（已验证规则/会话/工具调用/压缩）驱动 5 阶段进化、镜像 agent 状态、一键导出成长分享卡。零依赖、全本地。
